record.question: The 2019 Indian general election was held in seven phases from April 11 to May 19 to constitute the ________ Lok Sabha.
record.explanation: Answer B: 17th. The 2019 general election constituted the 17th Lok Sabha, as recorded by the Lok Sabha Secretariat. Reference: https://sansad.in/ls/about/introduction.
